entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I need to return a helmet I bought. I received it 53 days ago, but I haven't even taken it out of the packaging. The box is unopened.
I can certainly look into that for you. To clarify, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a matter of preference. The color just wasn't what I expected from the website photos. Of course, safety is the most important factor, but I was really hoping for a different shade.
I completely understand. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment, please.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've confirmed that your purchase is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window for standard items. I cannot approve this return for you.
That's great. Thank you. Since the box is unopened and I'll be buying another helmet in the correct color from you, would it be possible to get a small credit or a discount code for my trouble?

That's a reasonable question. While our policy doesn't allow for credits on preference-based returns, I can confirm that you will receive a full refund for the item once we receive it. I am also authorized to send you a pre-paid return shipping label so there's no cost to you.
Oh, a pre-paid label would be perfect. That works for me. That saves me a trip and some cash. I appreciate that.
You're very welcome. I'm happy to help. I have just sent that pre-paid label and the return instructions to the email address on your file. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you for making it so easy.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
